note: Measurements taken against the live AssemblyAI APIs. Each carries the command that produced it, so anyone can reproduce or contradict it. Updated by hand when re-measured; the method is in docs/decisions.md.

measurements.label: Time to interrupt, end of speech to first sound
measurements.detail: p50 over ten interventions, re-measured after the anchor fix. Min 1278 ms, max 1538 ms, and all ten carried a full end-to-end total. Budget is 2500 ms.
measurements.method: Ten live interventions driven by a probe recording, measured from the end of the advisor's speech in the recogniser's own audio timeline to Saakshi's first audio frame.

measurements.label: Of that, recogniser endpointing
measurements.detail: The wait before the turn is finalized dominates. Saakshi's own reply is roughly 210 to 320 ms of the total.
measurements.method: Breakdown logged per intervention alongside the total.

measurements.label: Judge-solo, one person drives the whole demo
measurements.detail: Roles bound, six advisor turns all from the recording, four of eight disclosures ticked, the planted claim interrupted.
measurements.method: A pre-rendered advisor mixed into the microphone stream, with only the customer played from a fixture.

measurements.label: LLM layer, prohibited-claim precision
measurements.detail: Recall 0.71 on the seven dialogues that reached a model; the two misses were requests the gateway rate-limited, not wrong answers.
measurements.method: Ten labelled dialogues through the LLM Gateway with a strict JSON schema.

measurements.label: Teach-back question generation
measurements.detail: One call per session. Five of five questions passed validation and none fell back to the pack.
measurements.method: One live call, then the same validation the room applies before speaking a question.

measurements.label: Cost of one three-minute session
measurements.detail: Streaming STT and Voice Agent time are billed per second; a figure will only appear here once it has been read off the dashboard for a real session.
